leadText:
Tu Yong-Ce (Chinese: / Tú Yǒngcè, sometimes incorrectly credited as Tu yong ce or Yong Ce-Tu) is a Chinese animator currently working in Japan. He began contributing to Pokémon as a second key animator on I Choose You!, before being promoted to a key animator on Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon. Following his time on the , he would continue to work as chief animation director for for over three years, returning to Pokémon to animate on movies or specials, such as Secrets of the Jungle or Paldean Winds.

He appeared again on Halo, the second opening of Pokémon Horizons: The Series.
